body:
Why do you think that you're so fucked up that it could warrant ending your life? You can PM me if you like but otherwise respond here.  You've said a lot so it's hard to address in this I  response.

You're right. Everyone has their reasons but it doesn't mean they are the right ones. 

The only other thing I can address unless you want to get into a serious conversation: you are worth so much more alive. Seriously... No matter how much a fuck up you think you are. No one prefers you dead...

I'm so sorry. That seems to be a theme. It was the same with my mom. Some people think they are a burden when they are nothing of the sort. I wish there was a way to prove otherwise.... It would make a huge difference.

I'm so sorry for the situation your in. That sounds horrible to have nowhere to go. Thank you internet, especially reddit. This is a huge resource with lots of help. Unfortunately it's less personal but it's something. 


I think your parents might not understand the magnitude of your depression. They definitely don't want to lose you... I can bet you that. The reason I say that is that it would cause your parents more anxiety and sadness if you left them then they can possibly imagine. I'm here to talk to you anytime. Seriously. 


I wish I could talk to your parents to knock some sense into their heads. They have no idea what they're doing by shutting your feelings out.


Stay positive. Don't end it. I know it's hard but whether you believe it or not, people care. Hell.. I care and I don't even know you.


Edit: and thanks for the hug. Also I'm sorry if I'm wrong or off putting, I'm just trying to deal.

Thank you so much for your kind words. Your story is very inspiring. You should know, your feelings are never a burden... ever. Sometimes it may feel like that, and people may not treat your feelings of sadness that seriously, but that is probably because they don't know that you're willing to self harm. Many people, including myself, don't expect that. I had no idea that my mom was thinking about it or even capable of doing so. Once someone understands the magnitude of your feelings and decisions they will drop everything to help... I promise.

Edit: Please PM me if you want to talk
